    About Me

    I am a B.Tech + MS by Research student in Computer Science at IIIT Hyderabad. My research lies at the intersection of 3D Computer Vision and Graphics, with a focus on 3D human motion, human-object and human-scene interaction, and geometry-aware learning for AR/VR.

    I have published work at BMVC (Workshop) and WACV, with ongoing submissions to CVPR. I am actively preparing for PhD applications in 3D vision and embodied AI.

    Research Interests

    • 3D Human Motion Generation
    • Human-Object / Human-Scene Interaction
    • Geometry Processing & Mesh Simplification
    • Scene-aware and physically plausible motion
